description: Defines the LayerSnapshotBuilder class responsible for constructing and updating layer snapshots within the Android SurfaceFlinger frontend. It manages hierarchy traversal, snapshot creation, updates, and rendering properties for layers.

classes.name: LayerSnapshotBuilder
classes.description: Builds and updates ordered lists of LayerSnapshots based on hierarchy and state changes, with fast update paths and various traversal methods.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing snapshots based on current layer hierarchy and requested states.

methods.name: getSnapshots
methods.description: Returns the current list of layer snapshots.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot by layer ID or traversal path.

methods.name: forEachVisibleSnapshot
methods.description: Iterates over visible snapshots in z-order, applying a visitor function.

methods.name: tryFastUpdate
methods.description: Attempts to update snapshots quickly if only buffer updates are needed.

methods.name: updateSnapshots
methods.description: Performs a full update of snapshots based on hierarchy and state.

methods.name: updateSnapshotsInHierarchy
methods.description: Recursively updates snapshots within the layer hierarchy.

methods.name: updateSnapshot
methods.description: Updates individual snapshot properties based on layer state.

methods.name: updateRelativeState
methods.description: Adjusts relative positioning and state of a snapshot.

methods.name: resetRelativeState
methods.description: Resets relative positioning of a snapshot.

methods.name: updateRoundedCorner
methods.description: Updates corner radius properties for a snapshot.

methods.name: updateLayerBounds
methods.description: Calculates and sets the bounds of a layer snapshot.

methods.name: updateShadows
methods.description: Updates shadow properties for a snapshot.

methods.name: updateInput
methods.description: Updates input-related properties for a snapshot.

methods.name: sortSnapshotsByZ
methods.description: Sorts snapshots based on Z-order for rendering.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a new snapshot for a layer.

methods.name: updateChildState
methods.description: Updates the state of child snapshots.

methods.name: updateTouchableRegionCrop
methods.description: Updates touchable region cropping for snapshots.
